25K likes, 621 comments - ilunarang on March 12, 2023: "SEYCHELLES OR BALI? Here’s how you can decide ⬇️
1. Seychelles has a direct flight from India that takes only 4 hours while Bali doesn’t have any direct flights and it takes 7-8 hours of fly time + layover to reach Bali.
 
2. Bali has cheaper accommodation and food. However you can get a serviced apartment in Seychelles and prepare some of your meals to save a lot of money

3. Seychelles beaches are incomparable! Crystal clear blue water, not crowded and a wide range of coral and marine life. The beaches is Bali are nice but extremely crowded. It’s a big spoiler for me.

4. Bali has a wide range of cuisines to offer especially vegan/vegetarian food. Seychellois cuisine is inspired by French food with a little touch of Indian cuisine. 

I feel they are both amazing places to visit and are quite different from each other.

If you have any other questions on budget, itinerary etc on Bali or Seychelles, please feel free to ask in the comments 😄

#baliguide #bali2023 #seychelles🇸🇨 #seychellestravel #maheisland #ubudlife #thebalichili #indiantravellers #indiantravelblogger #thrillophilia".

599K likes, 2,057 comments - ilunarang on December 31, 2022: "This is undoubtedly the most insanely blue water I have ever seen in my entire life! 🙌 
This is Zanzibar ❤️

It is an island off the East coast in Tanzania and has Visa on Arrival for Indians. It is far cheaper than Maldives and has incredible experiences to offer-

- Luxurious accommodations
- World class beaches
- Some do the best snorkelling and dive sites in the world 
- Dolphin watching tours
- Sunset cruise
- History, culture and the most fun people I’ve ever met

I’ve been to Zanzibar twice and I still miss it every day! It is slowly getting popular in Indian tourists now. 

If you have questions please feel free to ask in the comments 😄

#zanzibarbeach #zanzibarisland #zanzibarofficial #zanzibardestination #tanzaniatourism #indiangirlstravel #indiantravellers #thrillophilia #travelxp".

219 likes, 20 comments - ilunarang on January 2, 2026: "Share this with your travel partner 😍 
I've travelled to ✅ 20 states and 6 union territories in India and here's the list of best places to visit according to the weather conditions.

Jan- Kashmir to see frozen waterfall
Feb- Manipur to stay on floating cottage in the middle of Loktak lake
Mar- Rishikesh for Holi
Apr- Sikkim to see the frozen Tsomgo lake
May- Pench national park
June- Nagaland to trek to the "valley of the dead"- Dzukou valley
July- Kasol to enjoy early monsoon and pleasant weather 
Aug and Sep- are the best time to visit Ladakh. There are so many beautiful places to visit 
Oct- Hippie island in hampi has great mud houses to experience that rural life
Nov- Gokarna has great beaches and cafés for a tropical vacation
Dec- Goa has lots of great events in December and the weather is just perfect

➡️ Share this with someone you'd like to visit these places

✅ Follow my page for part 2 where I will show lots of other incredible places in India

#indiangirlstravel #placestovisitinindia #travellingindia #indiaunseen #loktaklake".

2,932 likes, 63 comments - ilunarang on December 29, 2025: "Follow for road trip and travel content ✅✅

I had a lot of people tell me "women can't drive" or "women can't drive well" and it's sad how many women quit or never even start because people around them are not supportive.

I made my own money, got my own car and then learned how to drive. It's the best skill you can learn for yourself. Don't worry about making mistakes. It takes time and you might knock it a few times lol but so do men! That's just part of the process.

My husband has been the biggest support for me to be able to drive with confidence on highways and mountains. We have done 2 major road trips:
1. Madhya Pradesh to Ladakh (Ladakh road trip 🏔️ )
2. Madhya Pradesh to Nepal (India to Nepal🇳🇵 road trip)

I really hope you learn how to drive this year! Rooting for my girlies ❤️

#womendriving #indiangirlstravel #indiangirlswander #ladakhroadtrip #indiatonepal
